** '''Watson:''' I am Watson, the master of clue scrolls. I have lived a long life here in Kourend. The lands are beautiful here.
** '''Player:''' You're the master are you?
** '''Watson:''' Ha! It is not so much due to my ego, but the fact that I give out master tier clue scrolls.
** '''Player:''' Interesting. Do you get many treasure hunters here in Kourend?
** '''Watson:''' I have seen many, but few are good enough. I only give out my clue scrolls to the very best.
** '''Player:''' Ah! I am just the adventurer you are looking for. If you hand me a clue, I'll be on my way.
** '''Watson:''' Not so fast [player name]. I require payment. You must bring me a clue scroll of all lower tiers.
** '''Watson:''' I will remember which ones you have given me though. I expect you'll find that useful.

* {{topt|What is that noticeboard for?}}
** '''Player:''' What is that noticeboard for?
** '''Watson''' It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
** '''Player:''' Oh that seems really useful! It's a bit of a shame I need to come here everytime to check though.
** '''Watson''' Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
** '''Player:''' I suppose you're right, I don't suppose you have a spare one I could buy off you to save me the hassle?
** '''Watson''' No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
** {{tselect|Pay Watson 500 coins for a S.T.A.S.H blueprint?}}
** {{topt|Yes}}
*** {{tcond|If the player doesn't have enough coins:}}
**** '''Watson''' I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{tcond|If the player's inventory is full}}
**** '''Watson''' You don't have enough space for it.
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{tcond|If the player has enough coins and an empty inventory slot:}}
**** '''Watson''' Here you go.
**** {{tact|(Watson takes 500 coins.)}}
**** {{tact|receives=[[S.t.a.s.h blueprint]]}}
**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|No}}
*** '''Watson''' Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Can you tell me about scroll boxes?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you tell me about scroll boxes?
** '''Watson:''' Well, the long and short of it is that scroll boxes contain clue scrolls, but in a much easier to carry form factor.
* {{tcond|If the player is on a normal world:}}
** '''Watson:''' Now, just because they're easier to carry, it doesn't mean you can take as many as you want. You'll need scroll cases to be able to store them.
** '''Watson:''' You can get scroll cases by completing clues. You can get up to two extra scroll cases for each clue tier by doing that kind of clue.
** '''Watson:''' I can give you the exact numbers, but I wouldn't worry too much about them. You'll get them eventually.
** '''Watson:''' If you want to help deal with the strange casket I have upstairs, I think it also has some scroll cases as well.
** '''Player:''' So how many scrolls can I carry right now?
** '''Watson:''' You'll find that information written on the statistics board by the door.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player is on a [[Demonic Pacts League]] world:}}
** '''Watson:''' I get the feeling that you'd be able to carry as many as you wanted for some reason.
** '''Player:''' Why do you think that?
** '''Watson:''' Just a hunch. I don't think I'm the best person to talk to about this right now.
** {{tact|end}}

==Using a clue scroll on Watson==
===Any tier from beginner to elite===
* {{tact|The conversation starts as if the player selected the "I have something for you" option from the standard dialogue.}}

===Master clue with an active Sherlock step===
* '''Player:''' You said you didn't know Sherlock!
* '''Watson:''' Sure is windy today, did you hear that?
* {{tact|end}}

===Master clue with any other active step===
* '''Watson:''' Sorry [player name]. That scroll is for you, not me.
* {{tact|end}}

==Using a master scroll book on Watson==
* '''Watson:''' Do you want to trade that in? You'd need another copy to take your scrolls out again. But I'll swap it for some teleport scrolls if you like, so you can travel here more easily.
* {{topt|Exchange the book for teleport scrolls}}
** {{tbox|pic=Master scroll book detail.png|pic2=Watson teleport detail.png|Watson exchanges your book for [amount] scrolls.}}
** {{tact|receives=[[Watson teleport]]s}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Don't exchange the book}}
** '''Watson:''' Come again if you change your mind.
** {{tact|end}}
